Navbar — Small pill-shaped physical button face on the navbar beam. Smooth clean anodized-black aluminum surface with chamfered edges. No writing, no characters, no markings on the surface at all.
Hero — Animated hero backdrop — atmospheric environment with drifting fog and dust motes (i2v, 24 fps loop).
Hero — Hero card — central surface containing the headline, subhead, and CTA.

Hero — Horizontal brushed-steel slab embedded in the hero card. Completely smooth, completely clean, completely blank brushed-steel surface. No inscription, no etching, no markings, no writing, no characters, no letters anywhere on the surface. Just the bare metal.
Hero — Hero subhead — clarifying tagline beneath the headline.

Hero — Rectangular pill-shaped machined aluminum button face centered in the hero. Smooth anodized-black surface with subtle chamfer. Completely blank surface with no markings, no inscription, no characters, no letters, no writing whatsoever on the face.
